verdict.rationale: Adyen documents split instructions that route part of each payment to the platform's own liable balance account while deducting costs, which lets the platform take a fee on transactions. Its marketing also claims fee control in the Dashboard. Reporting is described only generically as bookkeeping and reconciliation. missing for 10: explicit per-seller pricing or fee-profile configuration, reporting that separates platform revenue from processing costs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, payments are a revenue line — take an application fee or markup on every transaction, set per-seller pricing, and see my payments revenue reported distinctly from processing costs

citations.quote: you have to include instructions on how to split the funds between your user's balance accounts and your marketplace's liable balance account.
You can split the payments between one or more users, deduct costs as needed, and hold funds until payout.
Control fees and use payments as a competitive edge, all managed in your Adyen Dashboard.
use Adyen-generated reports for your bookkeeping and reconciliation processes to ensure accurate accounting of funds within your platform
